diagnostics.message: google_bigquery_table.views creates BigQuery views whose `view.query` (from var.views) may read base tables created by google_bigquery_table.default in the same dataset. BigQuery validates/creates a view against the tables its query references, so the views must be created only after those tables exist. Currently google_bigquery_table.views depends only on google_bigquery_dataset.default (via dataset_id) and has no ordering edge to google_bigquery_table.default, so Terraform may create the views before the tables, causing "table not found" failures during apply. Add `depends_on = [google_bigquery_table.default]` to google_bigquery_table.views.
